paper_title: Upper limit on the axion-photon coupling from magnetic white dwarf polarization
suggested_experiment_name: Magnetic White Dwarf Polarization Survey (SDSS J135141, PG 1031+234, RE J0317-853)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: Paper presents new measured exclusion limits on axion-photon coupling from linear polarization observations of magnetic white dwarfs (MWDs). Primary result is |g_agamma| ≲ 5.4×10^-12 GeV^-1 at 95% confidence for axion masses m_a ≲ 3×10^-7 eV, derived from SDSS J135141 data with conservative astrophysical uncertainties. This is encoded as a mass-independent (flat) bound spanning the stated validity range. Secondary constraints from Grw+70°8247 yield |g_agamma| ≲ 5.4×10^-12 GeV^-1 (comparable). The paper rigorously accounts for astrophysical backgrounds (bound-free and free-free absorption in MWD atmospheres), magnetic field uncertainties, and instrumental systematics. The mechanism is photon-to-axion conversion in the strong magnetic field of the MWD magnetosphere, producing detectable linear polarization.
